units.source_text: 源氏内大臣对使者申述未能参与宫中奏乐的歉意。

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, expressed to the messenger his regret that he had been unable to take part in the court music.

units.source_text: 但他觉得此间奏乐，因环境不同，故有凄清之感，反比宫中饶有意趣。

en.t: Yet he felt that the music performed here, because the setting was different, had a lonely, plaintive quality, and was all the more interesting than the music at court.

units.source_text: 便洗盏更酌，又添了醉意。

en.t: So he rinsed his cup and poured again, deepening his drunkenness still further.
